descriptions.en:
$1 doubling every second buys a new car at second 16, passes all the wealth on Earth at second 49 and could make everyone a billionaire at second 63.
Sources: Kelley Blue Book, US Census, Planetary Society, BEA, UBS, NASA, UN.
descriptions.es:
Un dólar que se duplica cada segundo compra un auto nuevo en el segundo 16, supera toda la riqueza del mundo en el 49 y podría hacer milmillonarios a todos en el 63.
Fuentes: Kelley Blue Book, US Census, Planetary Society, BEA, UBS, NASA, ONU.
